From: Elena Morales <elena@frostlinepay.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: BCP/SIG artifacts request for upcoming SIG assessment

Hi Kimberly,

We are preparing for a SIG assessment the week of Nov 24 and need to collect BCP/DR artifacts from vendors. Can you provide the following by Nov 18 so our audit team has time to ingest them?

- The latest BCP/DR runbook (high level + operations run steps)
- RTO/RPO attestation and the most recent test logs (table or CSV with timestamps)
- Evidence of keystore rotation and chain-of-custody for key material accessed during restore
- A SIG crosswalk showing where your artifacts map to the SIG control IDs (preferably an xlsx)
- Indicate if a live witness or recorded walkthrough is available (and available dates/times)

We can accept secure Drive links or S3 presigned URLs. Note: we may need redacted hostnames for vendor confidentiality. Please confirm scope and point person.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Director, Vendor Risk — Frostline Pay
elena@frostlinepay.com

Attachment: frostline_sig_request.pdf (their questionnaire)

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com

Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-10T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: BCP/SIG artifacts request for upcoming SIG assessment

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide all of the items you requested. Quick plan and clarifying Qs:

1) Delivery format: we will upload a secure Drive folder and provide S3 presigned URLs for large CSVs.
2) Redaction: we will redact internal hostnames and operator SSH fingerprints — please confirm whether IP-level data is okay redacted.
3) Live witness: we can schedule a 60-min walkthrough (ops + security) during Nov 20–22; if you require the week of Nov 24 we can discuss windows.

I'll coordinate artifacts with our Ops and Security teams and send a consolidated package by EOD Nov 13 if that meets your intake schedule (earlier than your Nov 18 ask). Ben and Marissa are on this thread to help assemble.

Deliverables we plan to include: runbook (PDF), RTO/RPO test log (CSV), keystore rotation manifest (PDF), SIG crosswalk (XLSX), and redaction notes.

Action: Elena — please confirm redaction policy (IPs ok to redact Y/N).

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Subject: INTERNAL: Frostline pay SIG ask — artifact collection plan

Ben / Marissa —

Elena asked for BCP/DR artifacts for Frostline Pay's SIG assessment. Can we pull the following and get them packaged by Nov 13? If any item needs additional approvals or redaction guidance, flag it.

Required:
- Redwood_BCP_Runbook_v3.pdf (ops run steps + contacts) — owner: Ops (Ben to confirm)
- RTO-RPO_Test_Log_20250912-20251101.csv (timestamped warm-start & restore attempts) — owner: SRE/Bench (Marissa to retrieve)
- keystore_rotation_manifest_20250430.pdf (KM rotation log + signatures) — owner: Security (Kim will coordinate)
- SIG_Crosswalk_Frostline.xlsx (mapping file) — owner: Compliance (Kim will draft template)

Notes on redaction: we'll remove internal hostnames and full IP addresses; keep service-level names (eg, inference-api.prod) where possible. Compliance prefers lower-fidelity network indicators to preserve confidentiality.

Ben — can you confirm ops contact (and whether we have a recorded walkthrough from Sept 2025 that we can include)?
Marissa — can you pull the CSV and redact any operator usernames?

I will prepare an intake folder and presigned URLs. If we can hit Nov 13 we'll have buffer before their Nov 18 deadline.

Thanks,
Kimberly
